[{"insert":"Strict Bar Dip Progression

The final strict bar dip session of the cycle in a descending rep format: 5, 3, and 2 reps per set with RPE increasing across the two halves. The first three sets establish a moderate intensity baseline. The final three sets push into heavier or harder territory. As reps go down, the load goes up.  Add weight or reduce assistance across the six sets. This is the heaviest dip work of the cycle.
"}]
